SAHUR PROTOCOL
TUNG  TUNG  TUNG
WASD / Arrows move | SPACE / J tap swing | C challenges | M mute
On touch screens: left stick moves, tap the right button to swing, tap top right for challenges.
HOW TO PLAY
Move: WASD or Arrow keys.
Swing: tap Space or J. Holding does not auto-swing.
Touch: left stick moves, right button swings.

On the beat: Sahur's TUNG lands on the music's beat. Swing on the beat too and you hit 30% harder (watch the BEAT light by your HP).
Protect him: in boss fights Sahur has his own HP bar. If he is knocked down, stand next to him to pull him up.
Challenges: each one you clear gives +4 max HP for the run. Press C to see them.

Clear rooms, choose upgrades, then beat bosses to roll new skills into your pool. His TUNG gets slower near the core.
STORY


Sahur comes from an Indonesian tradition: before dawn in Ramadan, neighbours walk the lanes beating hollow wooden kentongan and calling "sahur!" so everyone wakes in time for the pre-dawn meal. The meme of a log with a bat grew from that call.
